description: Returns, for one domain already added to this app, the one-click link that sets it up at the founder's own DNS provider when that provider offers Gemmein's one-click setup (Domain Connect): the founder opens it, signs in at the provider, sees every record and approves there — Gemmein never holds a login or key for anyone's DNS. The link points www at the app's Live site and, while the domain isn't proved yet, adds its ownership record. It is made fresh on each call, never stored, and meant to be opened straight away by the founder alone: Gemmein honours the return from the provider for 15 minutes, but a DNS provider may still accept an older link, so it is a link for the founder's own hands, never one to pass to anyone else. For a Live app the answer is always the guide and the steps: the one-click link is made only where Gemmein has switched one-click setup on. Without the link, the answer names the provider, its own guide link (only links checked on the provider's own site) and the exact steps instead. Each link made is on the founder's Logs; an account makes up to 20 an hour (10 while the app is in Development only). Changes nothing at the provider or in Gemmein; domain_check shows the result afterwards.

domain.description: a domain this app has, like example.com
